ModuleTitle.helper: Administrator-facing title for this module. This syncs with DNN module settings and does not display to visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used for #anchor-links on the page. Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

SectionEyebrow.helper: Optional. Small label shown above the section heading. HTML is allowed.

SectionHeading.helper: Optional. Main heading shown above the cards. HTML is allowed.

IntroText.helper: Optional. Short intro shown below the heading. HTML is allowed.
IntroText.placeholder: Use these cards to review industry-specific assumptions before final publication.

Cards.helper: Add feature items in display order. Image is optional; a soft placeholder is shown when no image is selected.

Eyebrow.helper: Optional. Small label shown above the card title. HTML is allowed.

Title.helper: Required. Card title. HTML is allowed.

Description.helper: Required. Supporting body copy. HTML is allowed.
Description.placeholder: Placeholder for mission and program environments where final language must be reviewed for compliance, procurement, and claim sensitivity.

IconClass.helper: Optional. Font Awesome class shown in the feature bubble. Leave empty to use the fallback icon.

Image.helper: Optional. Landscape image shown in the active visual panel. Leave empty to render the built-in placeholder.

ImageAltText.helper: Optional. Describe the card image when the image communicates meaning. Leave empty for decorative imagery.
